high_level_description: The image features a sleek, modern smartphone, specifically an iPhone 15, placed on top of its box. The phone is positioned diagonally, with the back facing the viewer, showcasing the camera module and the Apple logo. The box beneath it is partially open, revealing the phone's screen, which displays a gradient background. To the right of the phone, there is a small potted plant with green leaves, adding a touch of nature to the otherwise tech-focused scene. The background is dark, which helps to highlight the phone and the box.
